subject: OPEN statement
notes: kb/Work PB316 LANDED. GR20's normal form is now the bound tree's shape rather than a property of it: BindOpen flattens the repeated groups into one BoundOpenFile per file-name, in source order, each carrying its OWN group's open mode, sharing-phrase and retry-phrase - which is literally 'a separate OPEN statement ... for each file-name in the same order as specified in the OPEN statement ... each hav[ing] the same open mode specification, the sharing-phrase, retry-phrase, and REWIND phrase as specified in the OPEN statement' (cite.py --check 14.9.27.4, both sentences: OK). The statement node carries NO phrase state at all, so no consumer can re-broaden a phrase's scope; EmitOpen decides its sharing-aware routing per file from that file's own entry, where it previously computed one 'bool shared' for the whole statement. The two leaks the row recorded are gone and both were re-probed on today's tree first: REPRO A (rejects legal source) - 'OPEN OUTPUT SHARING WITH ALL OTHER F1 OUTPUT F2', F2 with neither a SHARING clause nor a LOCK MODE clause, was rejected COBOL1512 naming F2 while the same two groups in the other order compiled clean; both orderings now compile, and the complement (the ALL phrase on F2's OWN group) still rejects - conformance:cases/14.9.27-OPEN/pb316-open-sharing-all-no-lockmode. REPRO B (wrong answer) - a second group's SHARING phrase destroyed the first group's file-control sharing at run time; conformance:cases/14.9.27-OPEN/pb316_open_group_scope writes that arbitration twice, once as separate OPEN statements and once as one two-group statement, and requires the two to print the same I-O statuses (Table 19, row SHARING WITH ALL OTHER / INPUT against column 'sharing with no other' = Unsuccessful open = '61', 9.1.13.9 item 1). The RETRY phrase's scope is pinned on the BOUND TREE (kb/Work PB675): unit:OpenGroupScopeDriftTests.EachOpenEntry_CarriesOnlyItsOwnGroupsPhrases binds multi-group OPEN statements and requires every per-file-name entry to carry only its own group's retry-phrase and sharing-phrase, in both orders of a phrase-bearing and a phrase-less group. conformance:cases/14.9.27-OPEN/pb316_open_group_scope parts (1) and (2) stopped discriminating a RETRY leak when PB321 made every OPEN arbitrated (a leaked retry only routes the sibling through the phrase-bearing runtime entry, whose posture equals an unregistered connector's, and a RETRY phrase changes no status within one run unit), so they pin only GR20's equivalence of the written forms; the unit theory was shown to fail when the retry-phrase is hoisted out of the group loop. The row's previously VERIFIED-CONFORMING halves (per-file decomposition in source order; the RESUME NEXT STATEMENT sentence, probe openresume/OPRES01) are untouched. The REWIND-phrase half of GR20's second sentence remains vacuous because the phrase is still discarded - that is kb/Work PB317's GR-14.9.27.4-11/-12, not this row.
